_doc: Spec DC-000: where recorded legacy behaviour differs from the independent contract oracle. Each entry is evidence for the owning spec to decide, not a fix. Changed only by a reviewed PR; test_legacy_characterisation.py fails if the computed set of divergences differs from this list in either direction.

divergences.note: Legacy lowercases units (except exact mW/MW) and strips whitespace, so this spelling is read as a power unit. HA's UnitOfPower spellings are exact; whether Nimbus accepts a miscased template-sensor unit is a contract decision.

Legacy reads lowercase 'mw' as megawatt, a documented choice in power_units.py (a milliwatt house sensor does not occur in practice). The contract refuses it as neither exact mW nor MW.
No unit: read as kW by design ('kW was always the assumption'). The contract treats a missing unit as unresolved rather than assumed.
